transcript.text: It's hard to fathom when you're starting
out that someone can actually do 10,000
times more than you. The amount of
volume and repetition that is required
to excel in any domain is typically not
twice as much or 10 times as much. It's
usually in the order of magnitudes of
thousands of times as much work and
repetition as you think it is. I think
that is the fundamental discrepancy that
causes people to fail. It's that they
thought that I post one time or I'll
post 10 times and all of a sudden I will
become famous or I'll get viral or my
marketing will work on my 10th ad or my
10th door knocker or my my 10th email
that I do outreach on. That's when it's
getting me over the hump. It's like the
more experienced guys are like, "Okay,
how do I send 10,000 emails a day and do
that for 10 years?"
